plain_english_policy: HB445 (2011) is a state-level policy that establishes a mandatory process for the disposal of seized firearms in Alabama. It directs law enforcement agencies to sell confiscated guns through public auctions or licensed dealers, with proceeds earmarked exclusively for law enforcement purposes. The bill also includes provisions to protect agencies from liability and requires record-keeping on all transactions.
